reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on one post-hoc choice (north-region subsample, chosen as 'most comparable') with a wide CI (0.301, SE 0.396, roughly -0.48 to 1.08). Across the data the estimate is not stable: the full sample gives 0.671 (SE 0.223, p=0.003), south gives 1.07 (p=0.006), the bivariate north fit gives 1.87 (p<0.001), and adding all covariates flips the full-sample sign to -1.94, so absence of significance in one subsample does not support a claim of no effect.
